narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seven tenths take away four tenths is three tenths, so the finger is six and three tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the hand has four tenths, and seven cannot be taken from four.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The top number is the one we take from, so the order matters.
